title: SYMFLUENCE: SYnergistic Modelling Framework for Linking and Unifying Earth-system Nexii for Computational Exploration
description:
SYMFLUENCE is a computational environmental modeling platform that streamlines the hydrological modeling workflow from domain setup through data acquisition, model execution, calibration, and evaluation. A four-tier layered architecture governed by typed component registries integrates hydrological models spanning multiple programming languages and modeling paradigms, unified through declarative YAML configuration with provenance captured by default.

Described and evaluated in the three-part paper series "Out-standing in Every Field", "The Registry as Social Contract", and "From Configuration to Prediction" (Eythorsson et al., 2026, Water Resources Research).
